title: Delhi Sultanate
subject: History (CDS/NDA)

blocks.heading: ⚔️ The Delhi Sultanate (1206 - 1526)
blocks.intro: Five successive dynasties ruled Delhi before the Mughal era. Mnemonic: S ome K ings T ravel S lowly L ately.

blocks.heading: 1. The Dynasties
bullets: **Firoz Shah Tughlaq (1351-1388):** Built canals for irrigation. Set up public welfare departments: *Diwan-i-Khairat* (charity), *Diwan-i-Bundagan* (slaves). Founded cities like Firozabad and Hissar.
Sayyid Dynasty (1414-1451): Founded by Khizr Khan.
Lodi Dynasty (1451-1526): Founded by Bahlul Lodi. Sikandar Lodi founded Agra (1504). **Ibrahim Lodi** was defeated by Babur in the **1st Battle of Panipat (1526)**, ending the Sultanate.

formulas: Chahalgani: Iltutmish | Market Reforms: Alauddin Khilji | Capital shift: Muhammad bin Tughlaq
